spellbook.finance/limitations: An empty offers array means SpellBook has no current matched observation for this product. It never means every dealer is empty or that the buy price is zero.
Pokemon coverage is limited to exact matched English, NM/New CoolStuffInc source observations; unmatched rows remain excluded and are reported through missingFields or limitations.
Offers are observations, not executable quotes. They do not reserve a card, submit a buylist, or move money.

description: Read dealer buy offers for ONE exact card product, preserving each offer's game, finish, subtype, language, condition, source product, source timestamp, cash and credit fields, quantity and missingFields. Use the catalog product id from spellbook_printings_search. Pokemon offers are English NM/New CoolStuffInc observations when present; no offer or missing field proves a dealer has no stock. This read returns facts and does not choose a vendor or sell cards.

cardId.description: The exact printing or catalog product id from spellbook_printings_search. Required.
